archetypes.name: dyn-salvage-robustness
archetypes.rationale: New TSV/vote salvage paths risk false-accepting malformed input or corrupting already-valid output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Scrutinize the new TSV column-count salvage in research_eval.py (_salvage_structured_tsv_row, _leading_typed_fields_valid) and the markdown-table vote normalization in voting.py (_normalize_markdown_table_votes). Confirm the salvage only recovers rows whose five leading typed columns validate and never silently accepts a genuinely malformed reviewer row, and that the space-for-tab re-split cannot over-split a valid 8-column row. Verify the vote normalization is idempotent on already-anchored input, maps EXONERATE to NO, leaves table headers and separator rows harmless, and does not rewrite non-vote pipe-bearing prose. Check that both changes preserve existing parse behavior for well-formed input. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
